title: KiDoq A web server for predicting DHDPS inhibitors
protocol: Type the URL "http://crdd.osdd.net/raghava/kidoq" in your web browser.
Click the "Submit” button on the home page of the KiDoQ server.
Draw the chemical structure using JME editor or paste/browse the structure file in mol/mol2 format.
Select the type of file format if a structure is pasted or browsed.
Click the Run button to get the results.
